summary.goal: Define Step entity with scopes, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and gates
summary.context: Steps are the atomic units of work within a plan. They belong to scopes (repo/team/domain), have AI-inferred dependencies, owner roles, acceptance criteria, and optional human approval gates.

acceptance_criteria.description: Step has step_id, title, scope, description
Dependencies array contains step_ids forming a DAG
owner_role specifies role (e.g., 'backend:Coder'), not specific agent
AcceptanceCriterion has id, description, optional type
Gate supports type: 'human_approval' with optional approver_role
sub_plan_id allows referencing another PlanVersion for nested complexity

steps.title: Define AcceptanceCriterion interface and schema
steps.description: Create src/domain/criterion.ts with AcceptanceCriterion: id, description, type?

acceptance_criteria.description: AcceptanceCriterion has id: string, description: string

steps.title: Define Gate interface and schema
steps.description: Create src/domain/gate.ts with Gate: type ('human_approval'), approver_role?

steps.title: Define Step interface and schema
steps.description: Create src/domain/step.ts with Step: step_id, title, scope?, description?, dependencies[], owner_role?, acceptance_criteria[], gate?, sub_plan_id?

steps.title: Create Step factory function
steps.description: Implement createStep(title, options?) factory. Generates step_id (UUID), initializes empty dependencies and criteria arrays.

acceptance_criteria.description: createStep() accepts optional scope, description, owner_role

steps.title: Implement DAG validation helper
steps.description: Create validateStepDag(steps) function that checks for cycles and invalid step_id references.

acceptance_criteria.description: Returns true for valid acyclic graph
Returns false for references to non-existent step_ids

steps.title: Update PlanVersion to include steps array
steps.description: Update PlanVersion interface and schema to include steps: Step[]. Add DAG validation.

steps.title: Add unit tests for Step entities
steps.description: Write vitest tests for Step, AcceptanceCriterion, Gate schemas and factory functions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Tests verify schema validation (valid and invalid inputs)
Tests verify factory function produces valid entities
Tests verify DAG validation catches cycles
Tests verify DAG validation catches invalid references
